_notes.ctx_tokens: CONFIRMED customer requirement: >= 262 144 really usable tokens (docs/reassessment/ADR-012-reassessment.md:12@55db75d)
_notes.ctx_slack_tokens: CONFIRMED rule for probes: prompt_tokens >= 262144 - answer_tokens - 16 (docs/reassessment/BENCH_PROTOCOL.md:127@55db75d); reused for the decode cells (prompt + forced output >= ctx - 16)
_notes.decode_floor_tok_s: CONFIRMED customer floor 50 tok/s single-stream at filled context (ADR-012-reassessment.md:12-13@55db75d)
_notes.decode_target_tok_s: CONFIRMED customer preference 80-100+ tok/s (ADR-012-reassessment.md:13@55db75d); not mandatory
_notes.decode_min_output_tokens: CONFIRMED: decode at filled context = prompt >= 262144 - N, then N >= 512 output tokens (docs/reassessment/EXPERIMENTS.md:11,19@55db75d)
_notes.decode_filled_context_basis: PROVISIONAL choice (parity-qa) for the lead-architect: 'prompt_plus_output' (default) = the window is filled when usage.prompt_tokens + forced output >= ctx_tokens - ctx_slack_tokens, as in docs/reassessment/EXPERIMENTS.md:19@55db75d (prompt >= 262144 - N, then N >= 512 output) and BENCH_PROTOCOL.md:128@55db75d (--length-mode total); 'prompt' = the stricter reading 'prompt alone >= ctx_tokens', which a model with a native window of exactly 262144 cannot satisfy without YaRN (docs/reassessment/EXPERIMENTS.md:65@55db75d, K1)
_notes.min_bpw: CONFIRMED: every routed-expert tensor and every non-expert matrix >= 4 bpw by tools/gguf_quant_audit.py (ADR-012-reassessment.md:89@55db75d)
_notes.top1_agreement_min: PROVISIONAL (parity-qa, 2026-10-09). Exact routing is checked as same-weights parity: tools/quality/logprob_compare.py between the candidate engine and a reference engine (llama.cpp, all experts evaluated) on the same GGUF. Numerical noise alone (accumulation order, kernels) flips the greedy token only at near-ties, while skipping experts perturbs the FFN output of every token. ADR-012 D4 uses top-1 >= 0.9 for 'comparable quality' between different packs/engines (ADR-012-reassessment.md:85@55db75d); a same-GGUF parity bar has to be stricter. 0.97 leaves about 3% of prefixes for near-tie flips; with 200 prefixes the binomial standard error near 0.98 is about 0.01. NOT calibrated on this project: replace with a measured same-GGUF CPU-vs-GPU llama.cpp baseline (R2) before acceptance. Whether a given expert-skipping engine falls below 0.97 is UNKNOWN.
_notes.logprob_min_prefixes: PROVISIONAL: default --prefixes of tools/quality/logprob_compare.py (200); smaller samples are NOT RUN
_notes.logprob_max_errors: PROVISIONAL: any failed prefix makes the comparison incomplete (NOT RUN), it is never averaged away
_notes.logprob_tie_tolerance_nats: PROVISIONAL (perf-bench, N24, docs/evidence/2026-10-11-n24-owner-decisions.md section 2): a top-1 flip counts as agreement only when both greedy tokens are in both top-K lists and ref_gap + cand_gap <= this many nats (the change of the two tokens' logit difference between the engines; noise that moves every log-probability by at most d gives at most 2 d). 0.025 = 2 x 1.15e-2 rounded up, the largest same-weights |d log-softmax| measured on CPU with no discrete choice changed (N10, glm5-next tiny, llama.cpp f16 KV + FA vs f32). N24 CPU pairs (fa on/off, f32 vs f16 KV, both tiny models): 162/166, 144/166, 170/170 and 169/170 prefixes within 0.0125; the other 27 (up to 0.62) were not traced, so whether they are discrete routing/selection near-ties or continuous noise is UNKNOWN; the tolerance deliberately does not excuse them (they use the 3 % budget of top1_agreement_min). CPU tiny models only: GPU kernels (q8_1 activation blocks), real logit scales and the candidate engine are NOT measured and expected to be noisier; calibrate on the server (N24 plan: 2 x p99 of max_abs_dlogprob without discrete events, llama.cpp CUDA vs CPU on the same GGUF, never below 0.025). 0 = strict top-1 (the rule before N24)
_notes.synthetic_run: N24 owner decision: true only for a run on a SYNTHETIC (random-weight) model; then the criteria in synthetic_not_applicable are NOT RUN 'not_applicable_synthetic' (raw verdict kept and listed) if every bench run's model description carries the positive marker SYNTHETIC (upper case, whole word, not after non- or not; pack.py SYNTHETIC_MARK, N24 audit M1), and the overall verdict is never PASS. A real-model run must keep false
_notes.synthetic_not_applicable: N24: criteria that judge the model's answers (probe scores, the customer's evaluation set); random weights cannot pass them, so on a synthetic model their FAIL says nothing about the engine. Only ids in tools/verify/pack.py BEHAVIOUR_CRITERIA are allowed; probe request errors stay FAIL, and so does a json probe whose response_format was rejected (response_format_accepted false, N24 audit M2)
_notes.probe_thresholds: CONFIRMED tool defaults (tools/bench/probes.py:39@55db75d; docs/reassessment/BENCH_PROTOCOL.md section 5 @55db75d). needle 0.8 = K1; multihop/codeqa 0.75 are PROVISIONAL in BENCH_PROTOCOL (perf-bench proposal, lead approves)
_notes.long_probes_required: CONFIRMED: needle, multihop and codeqa PASS at 262144 (docs/reassessment/BENCH_PROTOCOL.md:126@55db75d)
_notes.probe_answer_tokens_max: PROVISIONAL (parity-qa): caps the --answer-tokens allowance in the prompt-fill rule so a huge answer budget cannot shrink the tested prompt; protocol uses 1024
_notes.prefix_cache_ttft_ratio_max: CONFIRMED: warm TTFT p50 <= 10% of cold TTFT p50 at the same length (docs/reassessment/BENCH_PROTOCOL.md:131@55db75d; docs/reassessment/EXPERIMENTS.md:47@55db75d, B3)
_notes.agent_loop_min_prompt_tokens: CONFIRMED: agent loop to >= 100K tokens without failures (docs/reassessment/BENCH_PROTOCOL.md:132@55db75d)
_notes.kv_min_prompt_tokens: PROVISIONAL (parity-qa): persistence is checked on a long state; 100K = the agent-loop bar of docs/reassessment/BENCH_PROTOCOL.md:132@55db75d
_notes.kv_warm_reprocess_max_fraction: PROVISIONAL (parity-qa): after restore the warm request may re-process at most 1% of the cold prompt, otherwise the restored state was not reused
_notes.kv_restore_max_fraction_of_prefill: CONFIRMED target 'restore <= 25% of prefill' (docs/reassessment/ROADMAP.md:61@55db75d); applied conservatively to restore time + warm re-processing time (PROVISIONAL interpretation)
_notes.roofline_ratio_max: CONFIRMED rule: a measured/bound ratio above 1 means the roofline inputs are wrong for this configuration (tools/bench/vs_roofline.py:6-7@55db75d); the pack then reports NOT RUN (invalid comparison), not FAIL, because the ratio is not a measured failure of the system (docs/reassessment/VERIFICATION_PACK.md:23@d89e633, V9: informational, but the file is required)
_notes.hw_expected_gpu_count: CONFIRMED customer statement: 4x RTX 4080 Super 32 GB (AGENTS.md:32@55db75d, hardware/4x4080s-32g.json); the pack checks the measured count against it
_notes.hw_required_facts: PROVISIONAL (parity-qa): regexes over fact names of scripts/diag/summarize.py --json; each must be present with a label other than UNKNOWN in a non-synthetic summary (GPU count, PCIe width, AVX2/AVX-512, memory channels, RAM bandwidth, P2P, H2D, NVMe fio)
